video_title: A Day in the Life of NBA Star Jared McCain | Cosmo Sports

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on his trade to the Oklahoma City Thunder
quotes.excerpt: I got traded to OKC and my birthday was right after the trade deadline.
quotes.quote: I got traded to OKC and my birthday was right after the trade deadline. Franklin is the name of the Sixers where I was, the mascot. I always like to commemorate a space in my life, a time in my life, and so I thought this was perfect because I still miss Philly.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on manifesting his NBA draft selection
quotes.excerpt: I said I'm going to be in that green room next year.
quotes.quote: I like to write notes when significant things happen in my life, whether it's good or bad. This one is probably my favorite one. It was my freshman year of college and we were all watching the draft and I got back from the dorm. This is the day of the draft, so it was 11:00 p.m., June 22nd, 2023, and I said I'm going to be in that green room next year. The green room is at the draft, they invite the top 20, 30 picks, and I'm going to hear my name be called. I know I am. I'm going to pick my suit and hug my mom, dad, and brother so tight. I'm going to cry, it's going to be euphoric. Keep working Jared and it's going to happen.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on his seventh-grade basketball goals
quotes.excerpt: I wrote these in seventh grade. It wasn't like I was the number one player.
quotes.quote: I wrote these in seventh grade. It wasn't like I was the number one player in the country, is what I'm trying to say, and it was this was going to be a given. These were definitely goals that were could looked at to be out of reach, but I always thought it's just it's just going to happen.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain on his nail injury during a layup
quotes.excerpt: I came out of the game healthy in my body, but my nail chipped.
quotes.quote: Last night there are a lot of things that could have went wrong. I came out of the game healthy in my body, but my nail chipped. I think it happened on a layup I went for. I got my head taken off but he also hit my hand. It was early in the game too. I looked at it right away. I wasn't even worried about my body at that point, I was looking at my nails.

quotes.speaker: Jared McCain
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared McCain and Alex on the viral nail art
quotes.excerpt: I received a DM from this girl and she was like, you should totally shoot your shot.

text_blocks.speaker: Alex
text_blocks.text: Growing up in Oklahoma, I've always been a Thunder fan. I had seen Jared on TikTok posting his little dances. I received a DM from this girl and she was like, you should totally shoot your shot to do Jared McCain's nails. I had already thought about it before, and I was like, okay, maybe I'll try. And I did and it went viral.

text_blocks.speaker: Jared McCain
text_blocks.text: Oh my god, there's 3 million views. I was getting tagged in it, here it is.
